articles.title: SAG-AFTRA Extends Duncan Crabtree-Ireland’s Contract and Adds CEO to Title
articles.summary: The SAG-AFTRA board voted Saturday to extend the contract of Duncan Crabtree-Ireland, the union’s national executive director, for four years and to add CEO to his title. Crabtree-Ireland’s contract was set to expire in 2028, but will now run through June 20, 2032.
body: Sean Astin, the president of SAG-AFTRA, praised Crabtree-Ireland in a statement after the vote.

“To battle giant global transnational corporations, we need expert leadership with a track record of successful bargaining and significant operational management expertise,” Astin said. “That is Duncan. He is a powerful executive who has led our union at the bargaining table, in the halls of Congress and in boardrooms and conference rooms across the industry and the world. We are thrilled to have guaranteed Duncan’s continued service to the members of SAG-AFTRA.”
The extension was approved with 98.34% of the board in favor in a weighted vote.

articles.title: ‘I Play Rocky’ Star Anthony Ippolito on Becoming Sylvester Stallone and Acting With a Dog: ‘He Wasn’t a Huge Fan of Me’
articles.summary: Anthony Ippolito had to do more than nail Sylvester Stallone’s signature voice to play him in “I Play Rocky.” He also had to transform his skinny physique to one with bulging muscles. “It had its moments for sure.
body: “I Play Rocky,” directed by Peter Farrelly, follows Stallone’s journey to get “Rocky” made in 1976. Now considered one of the greatest films ever made, the odds were way more against Stallone than with him when he first pitched the movie in Hollywood.
AnnaSophia Robb plays Stallone’s first wife, Sasha, in “I Play Rocky.” Stephan James portrays Carl Weathers. Rounding out the cast are Kiki Seto, P.J. Byrne, Matt Dillon, Tracy Letts and Jay Duplass.

If jitters on the first day of filming weren’t already enough to contend with, Ippolito’s first scenes were with a dog playing Stallone’s pooch Butkus. Stallone famously sold Butkus for $40 when before he found fame because he couldn’t afford to feed him. After selling the “Rocky” script, he bought him back for $15,000.

articles.title: Anthony LaPaglia: ‘There is not a role I didn’t get that I ever gave more than four hours of grievance to – even Tony Soprano’
articles.summary: The actor on surviving 2000s network television in Without a Trace, the role that made him take Brad Pitt seriously, and leaving the US to ‘ride out Trump’ Get our weekend culture and lifestyle email. I didn’t know before reading your new memoir that you were almost Tony Soprano.
body: It’s not Tony Soprano. There is not a role that I didn’t get that I ever gave more than four hours of grievance to. When I don’t get something, I move on. Because there’s no point. I’m very pragmatic that way. It’s for your own mental health. Once it’s gone, it’s gone.
If you were casting your dream project with three actors you’ve already worked with, plus one new face, who would be on your team?
Allison Janney. Kerry Armstrong. Alison Whyte. And a new face … I just saw Moneyball and I don’t think I ever took Brad Pitt that seriously but that guy is phenomenal. Great movie.
Acting opposite Janney in A View from the Bridge on Broadway sounds as though it was a transcendental experience for you.

articles.title: ‘SNL U.K.’ Weekend Update Tackles Meghan Markle Dad Allegations, James Bond Auditions and ‘Glee’ Reboot
articles.summary: “Saturday Night Live U.K.’s” Weekend Update isn’t afraid to tackle the most controversial topics, as the show proved again this weekend when co-host Paddy Young directly referenced the allegations that emerged this past week regarding Meghan Markle’s father.
body: That wasn’t the only provocative subject that came up during the latest Weekend Update. Young’s fellow host Ania Magliano also brought up the recently-announced “Glee” reboot – taking a shot squarely at the show itself.

“This week, it was announced that the musical comedy ‘Glee’ will be rebooted on Disney+,” said Magliano. “The original series was famously struck by repeated tragedies, including multiple cast deaths, and also being written, produced, and broadcast.”

Young also threw his hat in the ring for the James Bond auditions, which are said to be taking place this weekend, telling the audience: “I know this is late, but I’d like to put myself forward.” He immediately (purposely) fluffed it, bluring out: “The James Bond — bollocks.”
And he also threw in a shot at the BBC, saying: “In big media news, Radio Four Extra has announced it will close in what is sure to be devastating news for its listener.”

articles.title: Why the charts are full of old songs - and so are your playlists
articles.summary: The chart is full is full of old music and classic songs are dominating streaming services. But why?
body: More music is being created than at any other time in human history. Every day, more than 100,000 songs, external are being submitted to streaming services.

And despite the deluge of AI music, external - Spotify says it has removed 75 million "spammy tracks" from its catalogue - real music still makes up most of our listening. The streaming service Deezer says AI accounts for just 0.5% of streams on its platform.
The problem for all those artists creating new music is that our listening habits increasingly show a love for nostalgia.
Luminate, an independent entertainment data and analytics company that tracks music, film, and television consumption first started tracking music streaming in 2008.

articles.title: Why Dan Hibiki From Street Fighter (2026) Looks So Familiar
articles.summary: The Dan Hibiki character has a fairly major role in the 2026 Street Fighter movie. As for the actor who plays him? Well, he's already kinda infamous.
body: If "Street Fighter" fans were hoping for a more serious cinematic take on the gaming property after Steven E. de Souza's endearingly silly 1994 film adaptation of the video game, Kitao Sakurai's 2026 "Street Fighter" movie likely has them steaming. Though the film features martial arts performers in prominent roles, it's populated with comedic actors like Eric André and Kyle Mooney. If anything, it's more overtly ridiculous than de Souza's movie ( which may be why it isn't exactly tearing up the box office ).

Take, for instance, Andrew Schulz's portrayal of Dan Hibiki, a "Street Fighter" character who was created as a parody of Ryo Sakazaki and Robert Garcia from the SNK game "Art of Fighting." In Sakurai's movie, Hibiki manages Ken Masters (Noah Centineo), and he's played as an overconfident fighter who wincingly proves he's not an adept combatant at all. And while Schulz is listed seventh in the cast list, he turns out to have a very major role in the narrative thanks to his friendship with Ken. You may find their relationship amusing, or you might wish you were spending a little more time with the film's deep bench of colorful characters.
points: The Dan Hibiki character has a fairly major role in the 2026 Street Fighter movie.

articles.title: The rise of new black spaces in music
articles.summary: Young black creatives are continuing a tradition of carving out spaces to dance, connect and belong.
body: Driven by rolling log drums, syncopated rhythms and infectious melodies, amapiano and other electronic sounds from across the African diaspora are finding new audiences in a city celebrated for its musical heritage.
Behind these parties is a new generation of black promoters passionate about creating spaces where black people can hear their music, celebrate their cultures and feel like they belong.
But for some, building these spaces has also meant confronting the familiar challenge of finding spaces where black music and the communities around it are welcomed and not feared.
Bristol-based promoter Unkle Mykel's journey into events began in his own back garden after he moved to Bristol in 2017.

articles.title: TV stars to marry in chapel home after proposal 'on Welsh soil'
articles.summary: Keith Brymer Jones and Marj Hogarth are to marry in their chapel home in Pwllheli in May 2027.
body: The Great Pottery Throw Down judge Keith Brymer Jones has told how he and his partner are to marry in their north Wales chapel home after he proposed to her "on Welsh soil".
Jones said he and actor Marj Hogarth, who are renovating a Grade II-listed chapel in Pwllheli, were on tour "and I just thought I ought to really propose to her on Welsh soil".
He proposed during their show at the New Theatre in Cardiff, and "the idea is to get married in the main hall some time in May of next year".
The ceramicist also said there were a lot of derelict chapels across Wales and "we need to repurpose these buildings and give them a new lease of life".

articles.title: Jeff Garlin Considered Suicide After Tumultuous ‘Goldbergs’ Exit
articles.summary: The actor, who left the ABC comedy after an HR investigation stemming from multiple complaints about his behavior on set, says he reached out to his 'Curb Your Enthusiasm' onscreen wife Susie Essman to alert her to his plans.
body: After Jeff Garlin left the ABC comedy The Goldbergs following an HR investigation stemming from multiple complaints about his behavior, he struggled mentally to the point that he considered ending his life.
“I had a nervous breakdown, and I was going to commit suicide,” the actor said this week on Ted Danson ‘s Where Everybody Knows Your Name podcast.
“I reached out to Susie [Essman], and I said, ‘I hate when people don’t reach out, but at noon today I will be dead. I’m letting you know I will be dead.’,” the actor recalled.

“And she called [ex-wife] Marla, and she called [girlfriend] Sari and my friend, Brad Morris,” he said. “My girlfriend and my ex-wife called him. He’s one of my best friends. He watched me while they were looking for a place for me to go.”
